game_title: Fallback: Stack Of Plates – Moss Library
game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the relic hunter must hold off vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Then check stack_balance and advance.
player_objective: Protect the moon altar from vine horrors in Moss Library: keep stack_balance above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 5, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
